item.title: Sustainability LIVE: Leading the Transformation of Facilities Management for a Sustainable Future
item.description: In this keynote presentation for Sustainability LIVE, Kuram Gwakyaa explores how Facilities Management is at the forefront of the transition to a greener, more resilient future.

item.title: Sustainability LIVE: Exclusive Q&A with Mitie on Global ESG Strategies
item.description: Ahead of Sustainability LIVE: Net Zero at the QEII Centre, Kuram Gwakyaa sat down with Sustainability Magazine to discuss global ESG strategies, corporate transparency, and embedding DEI into business resilience.
